data.what_it_does: Provides annotations used by the freezed code-generator package to create immutable data classes and union types. This package does nothing without freezed.
use_when: You are using the freezed code-generator for immutable models
avoid_when: You are not using code generation or freezed
You need the full freezed generator functionality rather than just annotations
strengths: Lightweight package providing only the necessary annotations for freezed
Clear separation between annotations and the code generation logic
weaknesses: Does nothing without the freezed package
data.setup_notes: Add to dependencies alongside freezed and build_runner in dev_dependencies.

alternatives.name: built_value
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative approach to creating immutable value classes in Dart via code generation.

alternatives.name: json_serializable
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative code generator focused specifically on JSON serialization rather than full union types and immutability patterns.
